summary: Recent updates to the video colour conversion for Firefox improved how the browser handles YCbCr, a format commonly used for video broadcasting and streaming. This change enhances the accuracy and quality of colour representation in videos, ensuring that users see richer and more vibrant visuals while watching online content. While many users may not notice a direct change in everyday usage, these enhancements contribute significantly to a more satisfying viewing experience, especially for high-definition and color-sensitive video applications. **Overall, this update ensures that Firefox delivers superior video quality** through better colour management.
